The web client is incompatible with every billing endpoint. Three operations hard-fail; the fourth can silently return data for the literal ID `":id"`.

### Ranked production failures

| Rank | Operation | Contract disagreements | Production behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [`changeWorkspacePlan`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:34>) | Client uses `PUT`; API declares `POST`. Client sends literal `:id`; API expects the actual `team_id`. Client never sends its `plan` argument; API requires a `plan` query parameter. | Immediately returns **405**. After correcting the method, it returns **422** for the missing plan. If that is fixed without interpolating the ID, the API receives `team_id=":id"`, potentially mutating the wrong resource. |
| 2 | [`workspaceSeats`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:27>) | The supplied `id` is unused; the client requests `/api/teams/:id/seats` literally. | FastAPI matches `:id` as the path parameter. In the present implementation the endpoint ignores that parameter and returns `1`, producing a misleading **200 OK with the wrong seat count**. |
| 3 | [`createWorkspace`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:22>) | Client calls `POST /api/workspaces`; API declares [`POST /api/teams`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/api/billing/routes.py:15>). Client sends no body; API requires a `dict` body. | Returns **404** now. Correcting only the path exposes a second failure: **422** for the missing request body. |
| 4 | [`getWorkspace`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:17>) | Client calls `GET /api/workspaces/{id}`; API declares [`GET /api/teams/{team_id}`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/api/billing/routes.py:10>). | Always **404**. The scan missed this instance because the client constructs the URL through string concatenation. |
| 5 | Plan vocabulary | The API enum contains `free`, `pro`, `team`, and `scale`; the [client union](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:10>) contains `free`, `pro`, and `enterprise`. | API responses containing `team` or `scale` violate the client’s declared type. TypeScript will not reject them at runtime, so unsupported values can flow into UI logic silently. Conversely, `enterprise` is absent from the [canonical Python enum](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/api/billing/plans.py:10>). The current change endpoint uses plain `str`, so it may silently accept that invalid domain value instead of validating it. |
| 6 | Tenant terminology | The web calls the entity `workspace`; the API calls it `team`. | No direct runtime failure, but it caused the two `/api/workspaces` route drifts and makes future coordinated changes easier to miss. |

That is seven wire-level mismatches, three plan-value mismatches, and one terminology drift.

A further failure amplifier is that the client never checks `res.ok`: 404/405/422 JSON bodies are returned to callers as though they were successful `Workspace` results.

The scan’s `name_behavior_mismatch` finding for `getWorkspace` is not an API-contract disagreement; a getter performing an HTTP GET is normal client behavior. If recording detector feedback:

```bash

  --verdict fp \
  --note "Fetching a GET endpoint is the expected read behavior of this API client; no mutation occurs."
```
